decision_impact: Establishes docs/phase_f/L_LADDER_CANONICAL.md as the definitions source of truth for the L-ladder; plan.md ladder prose becomes historical narrative rather than definition. Resolves the L2.P umbrella question as non-operative terminology, avoiding a repo-wide rename of catalogs, registries, evidence indices and gate names.
output_summary: Authored the canonical, status-free L-ladder definitions note. Contents: (1) 28 Karr processes is the process denominator; the 18 Design-A per-tick rows and the 22 L2.2 in-scope rows are validation-profile subsets, never a coverage denominator. (2) One authoritative ladder -- L1a aliveness, L1b wiring conformance, L2.0 schema, L2.0a allocator input arithmetic, L2.1 deterministic/same-seed replay, L2.2 stochastic/distributional, L2.4 autonomous chassis conservation, L2.5 allocator-mediated shared-pool composition, L3 direct coupling, L4 submodel/cluster, L5 whole-cell phenotype -- each with definition, oracle use, integration scope and entry/exit meaning. (3) L2.P resolved as a NON-OPERATIVE explanatory umbrella for the per-process fidelity disposition: L2.1, L2.2, L2.event, optimization/FVA, windowed-continuous and condition-gated tests are evidence modalities selected by profile and applicability, not a universal sequential checklist. L2.P is barred from catalogs, registries, evidence indices, verdict strings, gate names and CI job names, so no artifact rename is required. (4) Terminal-state classes (PASS/VALIDATED, FAIL, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, CONDITION_GATED/OBSERVED_REGIME, NOT_APPLICABLE/DEFERRED) mapped to concrete in-tree tokens, with green vs terminal-but-non-green semantics and the rule that no condition-gated proposal silently unblocks L2.5 or L3. (5) Dependency ordering: L1b before L2.4, L2.4 before L2.5, L2.2 before L2.5 per stochastic participant, L2.5 before L3 entry certification; plus the allocator-mediated composition vs direct hand-off distinction. (6) Seven evidence-authority rules: live mechanical re-derivation, no stored-verdict authority, raw portable artifacts, content hashes over git plumbing, no zero==zero pass, no trace-hint/oracle-after laundering, primary-source selection hierarchy. (7) Deprecated-vocabulary crosswalk (original L1, L1c, L2.2.k, event-class as universal bucket, VERIFIED_GENUINE, 18/28-style denominator errors). (8) Explicit 'what this file does not contain' section pointing at the artifacts that own current state.
